stances.quote: Good morning everyone, welcome to the phase two diligence session for Project Falcon.
Acme Capital is pleased with initial diligence, but today we need clarity on financials and customer concentration.
Happy to walk through the numbers. For fiscal year 2023, Northwind Analytics generated eighteen million in total revenue.
And on the profitability side, Sarah? We have been analyzing the adjusted operating metrics.
Our EBITDA was 4.2 million for the last fiscal year, representing an operating margin of approximately twenty-three percent.
